text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Palestinian Jerusalem Affairs Minister Faisal al-Husseini.
- Casablanca hosts sixth Arab conference on civil protection.
- Budget will devote 40 percent of resources to social actions.
- National Commission in charge of elections follow-up studies campaign financing, use of media and constituencies division.
- Police seize more than two tonnes of cannabis in northern city of Nador.
- Interior Ministry says state will contribute 10 million dirhams for victims of Casablanca shantytown fire.
- Morocco to ease transit procedures for expatriates returning home for summer.
